feeds.title: International Organization for Medical Physics News
feeds.description: The International Organisation for Medical Physics (IOMP) represents over 27,000 medical physicists worldwide and 87 adhering national member organisations plus 2 affiliate organisations. The mission of IOMP is to advance medical physics practice worldwide by disseminating scientific and technical information, fostering the educational and professional development of medical physicists, and promoting the highest quality medical services for patients.

feeds.title: Medical Physics for World Benefit
feeds.description: Medical Physics for World Benefit is a relatively new organization. Our overall objective is to provide Medical Physics support with the goal of improving the effectiveness and safety of the use of physics and technologies in medicine, especially in low-to-middle income countries.

feeds.title: UWA Medical Physics
feeds.description: The Medical Physics Research Group at UWA conducts basic and translational research into radiation therapy, radiation biology, tumor modeling, molecular radiotherapy, radiation safety, clinical medicine, and health technologies, which will lead to new applications of physics, engineering, biology and medicine for diagnosis and treatment of diseases.

feeds.title: Medical Physics
feeds.description: Dedicated to improving the health and well-being of others through the advancement of the science of Medical Physics by implementing principles, methods, and techniques (in practice and in research) for the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of human diseases.

feeds.title: Intermediate Physics for Medicine and Biology
feeds.description: I'm Brad. I am an emeritus professor of physics at Oakland University and coauthor of the textbook Intermediate Physics for Medicine and Biology. The purpose of this blog is specifically to support and promote my textbook, and in general to illustrate applications of physics to medicine and biology.

feeds.title: Medical Physics Consultants
feeds.description: Medical Physics Consultants, Inc. began as a partnership in 1978, with one full-time and three part-time physicists. We are now a corporation with over forty (40) professionals including ABR board certified medical physicists and ABHP board certified health physicists.

feeds.title: Medical Physics Blog
feeds.description: A blog answering questions related to Medical Physics. Find articles on radiotherapy, imaging, nuclear medicine, and radiobiology.

feeds.title: UW-Madison Department of Medical Physics Blog
feeds.description: Medical Physics is one of 10 basic science departments at the University of Wisconsin School of Medicine and Public Health. The department has 30 faculty members, many with cross appointments or affiliate appointments in one or more clinical departments. These include Radiology, Human Oncology, Psychiatry, and Medicine. Several faculty have cross appointments in the School of Engineering, in Nuclear Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Biomedical Engineering.

feeds.title: UWA Medical Physics Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the UWA Medical Physics blog. Enjoy news and information about our teaching and research activities in medical physics, biomedical physics and biophysics.

feeds.title: NMPCE Blog
feeds.description: Northern Medical Physics and Clinical Engineering is a Clinical Directorate of The Newcastle upon Tyne Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust. The purpose of this blog is to be a reservoir of information, news, awards, publications, policies, and other information to keep our stakeholders and our staff informed of the fantastic things we do.

feeds.title: Ukrainian Assosiation Of Medical Physicists
feeds.description: UAMF is a public organization created for the development of medical physics in Ukraine!

feeds.title: Physics World » Medical Physics
feeds.description: News and commentary on medical physics. Physics World represents a key part of IOP Publishing's mission to communicate world-class research and innovation to the widest possible audience. The website forms part of the Physics World portfolio, a collection of online, digital and print information services for the global scientific community.

feeds.title: Versant Physics Blog
feeds.description: Read up on the latest news and announcements at Versant Medical Physics and Radiation Safety. Versant Physics provides exceptional quality consulting and software support services to healthcare providers. Our comprehensive line of services includes RSO & Regulatory Support, Clinical Physics Services, Odyssey Software, Personnel Dosimetry Management, online courses, and Commissioning.
